title: 4 Incredible New European destinations you need to fly! | MSFS Marketplace Update
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just loaded up a phenomenal collection of diverse European destinations this week! Whether you want to land at a rugged island cliff runway, tackle challenging short-field approaches in coastal Scotland, or explore beautifully updated mainline gateways across France and Germany, there is an adventure waiting for your virtual hangar.

In this comprehensive marketplace breakdown, we split today's major releases into two logical groups to see which environments genuinely deserve a spot on your virtual flight logs:

✈️ MAINLINE EUROPEAN GATEWAYS: We kick things off in the stunning southeast of France, checking out Nice Côte d'Azur Airport (LFMN) by France VFR. Known for high-quality regional scenery, this overhaul delivers photorealistic 3D buildings, reworked custom vegetation, and incredibly sharp ground markings perfect for holiday airliner operations. Next, we travel to Germany to visit Dortmund Airport (EDLW) by Salvuz. Recreated with an incredible level of handcrafted detail using extensive real-world references, this hub features a fully modeled terminal interior, a custom traffic tower you can see right into, optimized LODs for smooth performance, and true-to-life apron layouts.

🌏 SCENIC REGIONAL & SHORT-FIELD PICKS: Next, we head over to coastal Scotland to look at Dundee Airport (EGPN) by UK 2000 Scenery. Located just minutes from the city center, this historic riverside field brings highly detailed ground services, authentic custom terminal architecture, and surrounding regional details to life (just remember to download the free UK 2000 common library first!). Finally, we head south to the Mediterranean to tackle Kalymnos Island National Airport (LGKY) in Greece. Perched precariously on an elevated, rocky cliffside, this short-field challenge features custom terminal interiors, beautiful cliff textures, and an immersive atmosphere that will put your stick-and-rudder skills to the ultimate test.

Which of these environments are you adding to your flight routes first? Are you planning to practice tight cliffside landings in Greece, or will you be loading up a commercial airliner for a premium holiday hop into southern France? Let me know in the comments below!

If this structured marketplace breakdown helped you plan your next route, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism and scenery updates!
